-- AMBIGUOUS EFFECT --------------------------------- main.fango

`Fail` appears more than once in this row, with different arguments:

    {Fail Bool, Fail String}

and nothing here says which one is meant. Name it in a type the body can see:
a pattern on its payload, or a helper whose callback parameter lists only
that application, such as

    (() ->{Fail T, e} a) ->{e} Result T a

8| main() = print (case Fail.attempt { check 1 } of
                                     ^^^^^^^^^^^
